verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents actuals syncing from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet on a configurable nightly refresh, with the option to re-import past months after fixing the books. It also states that Ari 'builds the model and keeps it current' on top of a driver-based forecast, so fresh actuals flow into the existing Model without a rebuild. missing for 10: an explicit description of how forecast periods re-baseline or roll forward once actuals land after close (e.g., actuals replacing forecast months), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
